data.one_liner: A small Dart package for converting docx files (Microsoft Word) to string.
data.what_it_does: Extracts text content from Microsoft Word .docx files. It processes the raw bytes of a document and returns the plain text string.
use_when: You need to extract plain text from .docx files in Dart or Flutter
You want a lightweight solution with minimal dependencies for reading Word documents
avoid_when: You need to preserve complex document formatting, styles, images, or tables
You need to create, edit, or save .docx files rather than just reading them
strengths: Works across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Only extracts text (text only), dropping all layout and styling
Limited feature set for advanced document manipulation
